senses.gloss:
श्लक्ष्ण श्लक्ष्ण, adj.
 1. Small, slender, thin, Lass. 2. ed. 60, 19.
 2. Smooth, even, soft, Nal. 5, 5; Man. 8, 396; polished, Rām. 1, 13, 32, Seramp.
 3. Mild, amiable, Nal. 8, 12.
 4. Honest.
श्लक्ष्णय श्लक्ष्णय, a denomin. derived from श्लक्ष्ण, Par. To make thin or small, Pāṇ. iii. 1, 21.

श्लथ् श्लथ्, i. 1, and † 10, Par.
 1. To be relaxed, to open, Bhāg. P. 8, 12, 21.
 2. To be weak (cf. श्रथ्). []
 --With the prep. वि वि, To be relaxed, Bhāg. P. 6, 1, 60.

श्लथ श्लथ् + अ, adj.
 1. Untied.
 2. Relaxed, Bhartṛ. 1, 25; loose, Vikr. d. 146; flaccid, Ṛt. 6, 8.
 3. Dishevelled (hair).
 --Comp.
† श्लाख् श्लाख्, i. 1, Par. To pervade.

श्लाघ् श्लाघ्, i. 1, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., MBh. 3, 13306),
 1. To flatter, Bhaṭṭ. 8, 72.
 2. To praise, MBh. 1, 1; श्लाघ्य, Praiseworthy, Rām. 3, 55, 16.
 3. To boast, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 20. श्लाघ्य, Honourable, ib. 186, 21.
 --Caus. To approve, Hit. 61, 6.
 --Cf. κρήγυον, probably κόλαξ.

श्लाघा श्लाघ् + आ, f.
 1. Flattery.
 2. Praise, Pañc. iii. d. 33; Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1155.
 3. Boasting, Vikr. 56, 15.
 4. Service.
 5. Wish, desire.
 --Comp.
ऽश्लाघिन् -श्लाघ् + इन्, adj., in रण-, Chr. 20, 19, Praising, desiring combat (cf. the last).
